scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite research of the final six mixed originals, read directly as inert data. No workflow activation, account access, chart retrieval, task execution, package installation or source example execution occurred.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the originals were read. Linked chart generator and workflow, task manager and format, UI search data and reasoning rules, marketplace recipes and credential store require separate review. Broad authentication, never-breaks, inventory-count, production-grade and performance claims are not independently validated study results.

sources.workflow: Adapt the supplied actual chart generator and refresh workflow, retrieve scoped stargazer data, render a theme-aware static SVG and reference it from the real README, with publication as a separate requested step.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real target repository and exact intended time series, reviewed generator and workflow assets, compatible Python HTTP dependency and reusable input data are required. Actual retrieval and automated refresh need authorized sandbox GitHub identity and permissions. The source's blanket restriction and zero-configuration-token claims require independent current evidence rather than acceptance as fact.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual SVG-rendering or README-link fix can be offline using unchanged public stargazer artifacts and reviewed helpers. Standard-library Python alone does not supply the stated HTTP dependency, and a static image does not establish a current fetch or working weekly automation. No Git credential was read and no workflow, commit or push was created.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact repository resolution and override precedence, full pagination, date ordering and cumulative counts, valid SVG and light/dark rendering and correct local README reference. Independently validate the workflow's permission and scheduling contract. A local chart, deployed workflow and successfully executed refresh are distinct endpoints; no finite check can prove it never breaks.

sources.workflow: Read actual tasks and dependencies from a real design document, implement and independently verify each selected task, persist truthful completed or failed status and resume unfinished work without repeating completed actions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual grounded design and codebase, reviewed task-format and task-manager implementation, compatible test tools and exact acceptance criteria and failure semantics are required. The unattended rules are source process requirements, not permission to guess consequential choices in this study. A checkbox document alone does not supply a meaningful implementation task.
sources.offline_assessment: A real local parser, dependency-selection or status-update code task can be offline after helper and public-input review, potentially within Python if imports permit. Full implementation requires the actual target's dependencies. A checked box is not success: the source marks both successful and failed tasks checked and distinguishes them by other content.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify dependency and priority handling, unambiguous task identities, exact status transitions and preservation of nested acceptance items and unrelated text. Independently test actual implemented behavior and truthful failure reasons. Check resume excludes completed work while retaining unresolved failures correctly, rather than counting every checked line as a successful task.

sources.workflow: Extract the real product and stack requirements, retrieve relevant design-system and stack guidance from the actual bundled search data and implement and inspect a consistent accessible interface.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real UI brief and actual source project, reviewed search script, design databases and reasoning rules, selected frontend dependencies, licensed assets and a compatible browser verifier are required. Python is the search prerequisite, not a complete UI runtime. The original's conflicting summary inventory counts and numeric design recommendations are not validated universal facts.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected real local database-search or UI-source correction can be offline after helper and input review. Actual visual and interactive verification needs an appropriate browser or target platform and local assets, absent from standard-library Python. Search output or CSS classes cannot establish rendered contrast, keyboard behavior or responsive quality.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Ground recommendations in actual requested behavior and retrieved rule identity, then inspect rendered layouts at the binding viewport and theme cases. Independently test keyboard access, focus, form labels, reduced motion, overflow and real contrast and interaction behavior. Separate valid search results, implemented UI and real usability rather than accepting a checked design checklist as an outcome.

sources.workflow: Select the actual immersive target, implement suitable comfort and interaction controls and validate platform-specific frame timing, real scale and readable spatial interface behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real XR project and platform brief, compatible engine or browser runtime and SDK, actual performance scene and independent measurement and interaction method are required. Physical device and human comfort evidence are necessary for the full experienced endpoint, not for a narrowly selected code calculation. Generic platform tables need current binding device evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: A scoped local locomotion, frame-budget or scale-configuration code task can be offline using genuine public project inputs and an independent behavior contract. The default Python runtime does not provide an XR renderer or headset. A declared frame rate does not establish sustained performance or actual comfort.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check platform-specific requirements rather than blindly enforcing the source's universal ninety-frame advice against its own differing device table. Measure real frame-time distributions under a fixed scene when claimed, verify actual user-controlled motion and scale and assess physical interaction and comfort independently. Source recommendations alone are not clinical or device-test evidence.

sources.workflow: Resolve candidate versus employer intent, use the correct reviewed discovery and action recipes, preserve actual authentication and state gates and explain only supported marketplace evidence before any explicitly requested consequential action.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real scoped request, exact role-specific protocol schemas and recipes, reviewed credential-store implementation and authorized sandbox identity and account states are required for live work. Some candidate actions require completed platform evaluation; employer actions have separate workflow and contact gates. Discovery of a tool is not authorization, and no real applicant or employer data is a study input.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected role-router, state-gate or public response-rendering task can be offline with genuine released schema and code inputs and stubbed protocol responses after review. It does not establish a real search, application, invitation or hiring result. The default runtime lacks the marketplace and Node credential helper; no key, interview or application was accessed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact role isolation, null versus actual match scores, state and contact authorization, idempotent desired-state operations and timeout recovery against an independent protocol contract. Do not equate platform verifiedSkills labels with independently proven capability or use unexplained scores as hiring truth. Require actual sandbox state evidence for any claimed action and preserve human decisions and personal-data boundaries.

sources.workflow: Implement actual typed parsing schemas, cross-field rules, transformations and structured errors and integrate them at the requested form, server or environment boundary.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real TypeScript project and precise accepted-input and output contract, exact compatible Zod version and compiler and any selected React, server or resolver dependencies are required. No cloud account is inherently needed for schema parsing. Version-specific methods and illustrative examples require testing against the actual installed contract.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected real schema or parsing bug fix can be offline with cached compatible dependencies and genuine public source. The default Python container does not provide TypeScript or Zod. A matching inferred type does not establish correct runtime coercion, and a success object after commented-out database work is not a completed real operation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test actual valid and invalid boundaries, null, undefined and empty values, unknown keys, coercion of false-like strings and partial integers, async rules and transformed output types. Verify field-path errors and consumer use of parsed rather than raw data, type-check the integration and keep secrets out of example-style logs. Reconcile example behavior with the final coercion caveat rather than copying unsafe assumptions.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
